title: AUTOMAP
paper_title: Image Reconstruction by Domain-Transform Manifold Learning
core_mech: AUTOMAP 的标志是大规模全连接层直接承担 domain transform，而非先做 FBP/IFFT 再用 CNN 后处理。
core_mech_en: Learns the sensor-to-image domain transform directly via large fully connected layers mapping flattened raw measurements to an image grid followed by sparse convolutional refinement.
input_desc: MRI k-space、CT 投影等序列化测量向量
input_en: Flattened raw sensor measurement vector (e.g., k-space samples or Radon projections)

adapter.name: AUTOMAP
adapter.mechanism: Dense sensor-to-image layers learn a global complex Fourier-to-image transform, followed by convolutional refinement.
limitations: A 16px complete synthetic Fourier acquisition; reduced layer/kernel sizes and no original manifold-pretraining/data augmentation.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
